    ("1.2.3", "v1.2.3+build.5", True),
]


class ContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_cases(self):
        for range_, version, expected in CASES:
            with self.subTest(range=range_, version=version):
                self.assertIs(satisfies(version, range_), expected)

    def test_invalid(self):
        for r in ["1.x.3", ">=", "1.2.3 -", "- 1.2.3", "~", "foo", "1.2.3.4", ">>1"]:
            with self.subTest(range=r), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                satisfies("1.0.0", r)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            satisfies("nope", "*")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            max_satisfying(["1.0.0", "bad"], "*")

    def test_max_returns_original_string(self):
        self.assertEqual(max_satisfying(["v1.2.0", "1.1.0+b"], "^1"), "v1.2.0")
        self.assertEqual(max_satisfying(iter(["1.0.0-rc.1", "1.0.0-rc.2"]), ">=1.0.0-rc.1"), "1.0.0-rc.2")
